    7. For each operation, checks if it is a row operation (t == 1) and if the row has not been visited. If so, marks the row as visited, updates the `count` list, and decrements `r`.
    8. For column operations (t != 1), checks if the column has not been visited. If so, marks the column as visited, updates the `count` list, and decrements `c`.

    10. Iterates over the `count` list and appends non-zero counts along with their indices to `res`.
    11. Prints the length of `res`.
    12. Prints each element in `res` as a space-separated string.
